extras.notes: front faces -Y, origin on the rail top (wheel contact plane); buffer and screw coupling axis 1.05 m above rail top (Cozy Trains kit standard); blue fish belly side sills, wooden plank deck at 1.31 m, dark stakes in stake pockets, two stacks of nine logs each (bark, light end grain with rings) held by four yellow ratchet straps; load and straps are part of the mesh; bogies with wheelsets are part of the mesh (no moving parts); no lettering or reporting marks

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
